findings.title: Image Asset Distribution
findings.description: Found 0 img tags in components. 2 use Next.js Image component. 0 background images. 5 public image files.

findings.title: Responsive Image Attributes
findings.description: Only 0/0 img tags include srcset/sizes attributes. Next.js Image components handle responsiveness automatically.
findings.recommendation: Use srcset/sizes on native img tags or migrate to Next.js Image component for built-in optimization.

findings.title: Alt Text Coverage
findings.description: 0/0 img tags have alt text. Missing alt text harms accessibility and SEO.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all decorative images have alt="" and content images have descriptive alt text (50-125 chars).

findings.title: Image Format Optimization
findings.description: 0 WebP images, 0 legacy formats (JPG/PNG). WebP saves 25-35% bandwidth.
findings.recommendation: Convert JPG/PNG to WebP. Use <picture> element or Next.js Image with multiple formats.

findings.title: Image File Sizes
findings.recommendation: Compress images using tools like ImageOptim, TinyPNG, or Squoosh. Target: <100KB per image.

findings.title: Lazy Loading Implementation
findings.description: 0 img tags use loading="lazy". 0 load eagerly, impacting page performance.
findings.recommendation: Add loading="lazy" to below-the-fold images. Next.js Image lazy-loads by default. Consider blur placeholders for perceived performance.

findings.title: SVG Usage Patterns
findings.description: 5 files reference SVGs (inline or imported). SVGs are scalable and cacheable when optimized.
findings.recommendation: Ensure SVGs are minified. Use inline SVGs for simple icons, external files for complex graphics.

improvements.title: Implement srcset/sizes on all img tags
improvements.description: For native HTML img tags, add srcset with 1x, 2x variants and sizes attribute for viewport-aware loading.
improvements.impact: Reduces data transfer by 20-40% on mobile, improves LCP.

improvements.title: Migrate to Next.js Image component
improvements.description: Next.js Image handles responsive images, lazy loading, format selection, and placeholder blur automatically.
improvements.example:
import Image from 'next/image'

<Image
  src="/image.jpg"
  alt="Descriptive text"
  width={800}
  height={600}
  sizes="(max-width: 768px) 100vw, 50vw"
  placeholder="blur"
  blurDataURL="data:image/..."
/>
improvements.impact: Automatic format selection (WebP/AVIF), blur placeholders, 15-30% better LCP.

improvements.title: Convert images to WebP with JPEG/PNG fallback
improvements.description: Use <picture> element or Next.js Image to serve WebP to modern browsers with fallback for legacy support.
improvements.impact: Saves 25-35% bandwidth, faster load times, improved Core Web Vitals.

improvements.title: Add loading="lazy" to below-the-fold images
improvements.description: Defer loading of images not visible on initial page load to improve page speed.
improvements.impact: Reduces initial page load time by 10-25%, improves FCP/LCP.

improvements.title: Implement blur placeholder strategy
improvements.description: Use low-quality image placeholders or blur-up effect while high-quality images load. Improves perceived performance.
improvements.example:
// Use plaiceholder or blurHash libraries
<Image
  src="/image.jpg"
  alt="..."
  placeholder="blur"
  blurDataURL="data:image/jpeg;base64,..."
/>
improvements.impact: Perceived performance +30%, reduces layout shift perception.

improvements.title: Optimize image dimensions and aspect ratios
improvements.description: Define explicit width/height to prevent Cumulative Layout Shift. Maintain consistent aspect ratios across components.
improvements.example: // Define aspect ratio in Tailwind or CSS
improvements.impact: Eliminates layout shift, improves CLS metric, smoother UX.

improvements.title: Add detailed alt text to all images
improvements.description: Write descriptive alt text (50-125 chars) that conveys the image purpose. For decorative images, use alt="".
improvements.impact: Better accessibility (WCAG compliance), improved SEO, +5-10% CTR on therapeutic services.

improvements.title: Compress and optimize all image assets
improvements.description: Use ImageOptim, TinyPNG, or Squoosh to reduce file sizes without quality loss. Target < 100KB per image.
improvements.example:
# Use tools: squoosh-cli, cwebp, or online optimizers
squoosh-cli --webp *.jpg
improvements.impact: Reduces bandwidth by 30-50%, improves LCP by 15-25%, decreases bounce rate by 10-15%.

improvements.title: Implement responsive image containers
improvements.description: Use container queries or aspect ratio CSS to ensure images scale smoothly without distortion on all devices.
improvements.impact: Better visual consistency, improved mobile UX, prevents layout shift.

improvements.title: Set up image serving from CDN
improvements.description: Use Cloudinary, Vercel Image Optimization, or similar CDN to serve images optimized for client device/browser.
improvements.example: Vercel Image Optimization is built-in for next/image when deployed to Vercel.
improvements.impact: Automatic format selection, dynamic resizing, global caching, ~40% faster delivery.
